fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized timestamp of when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Provides the common time value needed to correlate events across sources.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system associated with the event.
fields.justification: Identifies the system involved in an event for investigation and correlation.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Identifies the originating telemetry source type.
fields.justification: Allows downstream rules and analysts to distinguish Windows, Linux, and network evidence.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: Normalized high-level category of the event.
fields.justification: Provides a consistent category for detection rules, filtering, and triage.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity rating assigned to the event.
fields.justification: Helps prioritize events during detection and analyst triage.

source_mapping.linux_text: derived from event type or null

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports investigation of account activity and authentication behavior.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name of the process associated with the event.
fields.justification: Enables process-based detection and investigation of suspicious execution.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Identifier of the process associated with the event.
fields.justification: Helps correlate related process activity within host telemetry.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports network correlation, threat detection, and investigation of event origin.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports network-flow correlation and identification of suspicious connections.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports detection and investigation of outbound and lateral network activity.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Allows detection rules to identify connections to sensitive or unusual services.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network protocol associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports protocol-based detection and network event classification.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Original numeric event identifier when provided by the source.
fields.justification: Preserves source-specific event identity for precise detection and investigation.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Original telemetry provider or logging component that generated the event.
fields.justification: Preserves source context needed to interpret and investigate events correctly.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original unmodified message or event representation.
fields.justification: Preserves source evidence so analysts can verify normalized fields during investigation.

fields.name: event_data
fields.description: Additional structured fields retained from the original event.
fields.justification: Preserves source-specific details that may be required by future detections or investigations.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Identifies whether the record came from the evidence pack or student telemetry.
fields.justification: Maintains provenance so analysts can distinguish provided evidence from student-generated telemetry.
